comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/sketch-line-extensions.mitcad-ui (mitcad#2035): Sketch1 (F1) on XY with a fixed point p1 at (-10, 0); a vertical line c2 from (20, 0) to (20, 20) (points p3, p4), held vertical (k1) and 30 mm right of p1 by a horizontal distance k2; a level line c5 from (36, 50) to (56, 50) and a vertical line c8 from (70, 8) to (70, 32), whose extensions meet at (70, 50), beyond both; a free point p11 at (100, 80) that keeps the meeting point away from the view's top right corner (the orientation cube) after a fit.
